decision: The competitor (Red Bull Toro Rosso Honda) is fined €5000.
event_name: Document 28 Date 30 November 2019 Time 18:53 2019 ABU DHABI GRAND PRIX 28 November - 1 December 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 25 & 26) and heard from the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine
offence: Breach of Article 28.13 (a) of the 2019 FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence, heard from the drivers of Car 26 (Daniil Kvyat) and Car 8 (Romain Grosjean) and the team representatives. Car 26 was released from the garage in an unsafe manner resulting in Car 8 having to take evasive action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Toro Rosso Unsafe Release
to: The Team Manager, Red Bull Toro Rosso Honda
